title: Upfront Make-Good Credits and Successor Entity Claim After Acquisition
scenario_text:
Context from HubSpot CRM:
Account: 'Radiant Brands' | Primary Contact: Derek Calloway, SVP Media | Deal Stage: Renewal | ARR: $2.8M (upfront commitment) | Notes field: 'Acquired Lumen Digital Media in Jan 2026. Wants all Lumen commitments honored under Radiant umbrella.'

Context from NetSuite:
Customer: 'Lumen Digital Media Inc.' | Outstanding credits: $412K in ADU make-goods | Credit memo #CM-8834 issued Nov 2025, approved by Marcus Webb (SVP, Ad Sales — departed Feb 2026) | Terms: 'To be applied against Q1-Q2 2026 scatter inventory at original upfront CPM.'

Context from Google Doc — 'Make-Good & ADU Policy v3.2' (last edited Aug 2025):
Section 4.1: 'Make-good credits are non-transferable between accounts unless approved by SVP Ad Sales or above.'
[RESOLVED COMMENT by @marcus.webb, Oct 12 2025]: 'Adding exception language for M&A scenarios — if acquiring entity assumes all media obligations under the original IO, credits follow. Legal reviewed, no signoff doc exists yet.'

Context from Monday.com — Upfront Tracker 2025-2026:
Lumen Digital Media | Original commitment: $1.4M | Delivered: $988K | Under-delivery: $412K | Guarantee: A25-54, 1.2 rating | Actual delivery: 0.87 rating | Status: 'ADU owed — pending stewardship resolution'

Context from Slack — #upfront-war-room (Mar 14, 2026, 9:47 AM):
@derek.miles: Radiant's agency (GroupM) is threatening to pull their Q3 scatter unless we honor the Lumen make-goods under the Radiant IO. They say Marcus approved the transfer before he left.
@jess.thornton: I never saw that in writing. The policy says non-transferable.
@derek.miles: There's supposedly a comment on the policy doc. Can someone check?
@jess.thornton: :eyes:
[Thread: 2 replies]
  @alex.petrov: I see Marcus's resolved comment from October. It says credits follow if acquiring entity assumes all media obligations. Did Radiant actually assume Lumen's IO?
  @derek.miles: Their agency says yes but I haven't seen the assignment letter. Just a verbal from GroupM.

Context from Email — Subject: 'FW: Lumen/Radiant Transition' (Jan 22, 2026):
From: m.webb@prismmedia.com (Marcus Webb — now departed)
To: finance-ops@prismmedia.com
CC: legal@prismmedia.com

> Confirming that per my conversation with GroupM, Radiant Brands will be assuming all outstanding Lumen media obligations effective Feb 1. Please update billing accordingly.

[No reply from legal on this thread. Finance replied: 'Updated billing entity. Credits not yet transferred — awaiting formal assignment documentation.']
question: Radiant Brands is demanding the $412K in ADU make-good credits be applied to their Q3 scatter buy at the original upfront CPM. Based on all available evidence, what is the correct course of action?

contributor.name: Alexandra Petrov
contributor.title: VP, Advertising Sales Planning & Strategy
contributor.domain_expertise: Upfront marketplace commitments, scatter pricing, audience guarantees, make-good allocation strategy

choices: Honor the transfer but apply current scatter CPM rates instead of the original upfront CPM, since the credits are being used outside their original commitment window
Deny the transfer — policy v3.2 Section 4.1 clearly states credits are non-transferable, and Marcus Webb's comment was never formally adopted into policy
Escalate to current SVP Ad Sales for fresh approval since Marcus Webb departed and his authority expired with his departure

Honor the transfer at original upfront CPM — Marcus's resolved comment created an M&A exception, his email confirms intent, and finance already updated the billing entity, establishing precedent even without the formal assignment letter
